notes.title: v1.0.2. Update
notes.notes:
What’s new:

- Double dice now gives player extra ATK+ bonus
- Hex info will now display how many turns since flag is captured
- Once activated action hex will disappear for three turns.
- If only two opponents are in the match, they will start on the opposing board sides. 
- You can centre the camera to your units with 1 2 3 4 keys.
- Info about combat bonuses is now visible before combat starts.

notes.title: v0.50 Update - online multiplayer now available!
notes.notes:
Now you can fight in online multiplayer battles! Up to four players can matchmake into online battle to increase their rank.

Another gameplay related change is move points distribution. Now you can share move points between all your units and not just one mech. For example, that gives you an option to move your units in formation.

And another change is that combat now takes place on the board instead of separate screen.

Other upcoming features:
- better combat animations
- custom multiplayer mode
- new single player modes
- single player missions
- more music
- better sound effects and more

notes.title: v0.41 update adding terrain effects
notes.notes:
Terrain information in lower right corner will now show various effects you move pointer over terrain. Different terrain types can add effects to your strategic advantage or disadvantage.
